description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the count of different evaluation types across two models. The x-axis is labeled "Model" and displays two categorical groups; the label for the first group is obscured by a solid grey rectangle, while the second group is labeled "Mistral 7B". The y-axis is labeled "Count" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 120, with tick marks and corresponding horizontal dashed grid lines at regular intervals of 20. The chart displays five categories defined in the legend under "Type": Type1 (teal), Type2 (salmon), Type3 (grey-blue), RR (pink), and WW (yellow-green). For the first obscured model on the left, the bar heights are approximately 15 for Type1, 25 for Type2, near 1 for Type3, 122 for RR, and 36 for WW. For the Mistral 7B model on the right, the bar heights are approximately 29 for Type1, 26 for Type2, 0 for Type3 (not visible), 114 for RR, and 31 for WW.
